root.title: Scout of the Far Lanterns
root.text:
You found the road back. That is the part I care about. I am Iona. Eldara has the main chronicle; my maps, ranger work, and unfinished journeys could use another traveler who knows when to turn around.

An End portal frame already stands at the Spire. Earn its keys progressively through The Lost Eyes | NPC Trials. Start with Sera after Eldara's The First Hearth; follow each trial's named companion and story milestone. The first twelve trials award twelve different End Remastered eyes. Keep them for the Spire frame instead of throwing them to search for a stronghold.

work.title: Your work
work.text: I draw safe returns before destinations. Some paths need a lantern; others need to stay undisturbed. The atlas belongs to the next scout as much as it belongs to me. Ask about my maps, and I may finally tell you about the valley I left blank.

quests.title: How can I help?
quests.text: Choose Covenant quests in our opening conversation to see my assignments. Accept one here before setting out, then return to me to turn it in and receive your emeralds. Use the minus key (-) to track its objectives while traveling. Some requests follow earlier work; your journal explains what must be finished first. If the Ashen Covenant quest mod is absent, I can still talk, but cannot offer its quests.

eldara.title: The main chronicle
eldara.text: Speak to Eldara and choose Main quests to continue the three books of the Ashen Covenant. She receives the expedition reports and gives the next main assignment. The rest of us have our own work, and we will ask for it in person.
